result_summary.title: Certificate warnings in Payment Gateway ME
result_summary.description: Users in the Middle East are seeing certificate warnings when trying to access Payment Gateway v2. We are pretty sure this is because of a third-party service failure, possibly an upstream issue with our certificate provider or a global outage affecting trust chains. It is affecting about 53 users.
